verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

verse.name: c1
v2
verse.lines:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Stay Thou nearby;
Temptations lose their pow’r
When Thou art nigh.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Teach me Thy will;
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfill.
